question: Do additional correct documentation facts improve local shared-mechanism discovery, separately from representation changes?
primary_task: Discover specified local shared mechanisms; not whole-function equivalence or merge worthiness

panels.controlled: Reference mechanism boundary, adaptation conditions, retained differences and explicit observable domain; constructed labels are not natural prevalence
panels.natural: Pinned real candidates with independent dimension-specific judgments; current 43 pairs are development/review material, not held-out

required_claims: ordering, concurrency and configuration if applicable
provenance, version and explicit unknown/not-applicable reasons
truth: Claim ledger connects each statement to source, execution or explicitly selected normative requirement. Provider approval separate from researcher authorship. No universal Rust documentation completeness claim
controls: Code, candidate universe, truth labels and budget fixed across document arms
Code-only arm excludes doc comments/attributes and must not change under doc intervention
Wrong documentation does not change code truth
Output inequality is not a negative sharing label
No peer IDs, desired labels or post-refactoring explanations in detector documents
No assumption that omission/corruption monotonically decreases similarity
Bidirectional claim alignment before same-information comparison
splits: Transitive ancestry, endpoint, copied snippet, template, PR and semantic family grouping before split; all document variants stay together. Mechanical graphs do not certify semantic independence. Existing xkernel pool, eight-function fixtures and screened related repositories remain development
methods: Reuse frozen token frontend and TF-IDF. Fix any new representation on development data before test; no tuning k to known anchors
fitting: Development-only vocabulary/IDF; explicitly separate any transductive variant; count empty/OOV vectors
metrics: per-family known-reference recall at fixed budget only with a valid positive denominator
judgment coverage and unknown relevance bounds
confirmation witness errors and abstentions separately
authoring, verification, extraction and execution costs separately
statistics: Generated variants are not independent samples; freeze final family count and estimand before significance claims; no whole-repository recall from incomplete labels
pending_gates: pinned source inventory and exposure/ancestry audit
mechanism labels with evidence and observation bounds
fixed candidate budget, sample count and method revisions
next_batch: Inventory one pinned rust-lang/rust core/alloc snapshot and source-level historical evidence without similarity ranking; verify license and identity, retain exclusions, do not replace candidates based on scores
stop: No effectiveness execution or claim until gates pass; if no eligible families, report that instead of renaming old examples as new tests
